decks.notes: The deck focuses on generating high amounts of green mana devotion to power up various green creatures and spells quickly, while also utilizing Leyline of the Guildpact to protect against removal. The deck includes a mix of aggressive creatures like Outcaster Trailblazer and Old-Growth Troll, as well as powerful ramp cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Storm the Festival. Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner helps provide additional ramp and card draw, while Lair of the Hydra and Boseiju, Who Endures offer additional versatility and protection. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast, aggressive strategy fueled by green mana devotion.

This deck utilizes a powerful control strategy focused on using Zur, Eternal Schemer to search for key cards and control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Vanishing Verse. The mana base is designed to support the deck's three-color requirements while also providing utility lands like Boseiju, Who Endures and Cavern of Souls. By efficiently controlling the game and using Zur's abilities to advantage, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents to secure victory in Pioneer 1 vs 1 matches.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions and board presence through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and versatile creatures. By utilizing the toolbox nature of Bring to Light, the deck can find answers to a variety of threats and situations. Niv-Mizzet Reborn acts as a powerful card advantage engine, providing additional resources and threats. The inclusion of different Triomes allows for flexible mana fixing, while the Companion Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value through blinking permanents. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents to secure victory.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck includes low-cost creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Callous Sell-Sword, alongside powerful burn spells like Reckless Rage and Monstrous Rage. The goal is to quickly deal damage to the opponent and control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push. The deck also utilizes land cards like Den of the Bugbear and Ramunap Ruins to provide additional damage and reach. Overall, the strategy revolves around fast and relentless aggression to outpace and defeat the opponent.

The deck focuses on using Enigmatic Incarnation as a control tool to tutor for powerful creatures such as Overlords and Skyclave Apparition, while also utilizing Leyline Binding and Vanishing Verse to control the opponent's board. The deck also includes cards like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Nowhere to Run to further disrupt the opponent's strategy. The companion Yorion, Sky Nomad provides additional value by flickering creatures and permanents for extra value. By combining control elements with powerful creatures, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a grindy match-up.

This deck focuses on aggressive play with a Rakdos color combination, utilizing efficient creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck includes powerful cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Blade of the Oni to close out games quickly. It also includes disruption spells like Duress and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The mana base is carefully crafted to support a fast and consistent aggressive strategy. With a mix of efficient removal, disruption, and powerful threats, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and win the game before the opponent can stabilize.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays, utilizing cards that allow for early disruption (such as Thoughtseize and Duress) while also putting pressure on the opponent with powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with opposing threats. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's black and red requirements, with key lands like Blood Crypt and Mutavault providing additional utility. Overall, this deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while quickly establishing a threatening board presence.

The deck focuses on aggressively removing opponents' threats and disrupting their hand with cards like Thoughtseize while also utilizing powerful creatures like Unstoppable Slasher and Bloodtithe Harvester to deal consistent damage and pressure. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out games. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the deck's aggressive game plan while providing the necessary colors for its spells. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and efficiently to secure a victory.

The key concept of the deck is to use a combination of spirits and tempo-based spells to maintain control of the game while applying consistent pressure on the opponent. By utilizing creatures like Mausoleum Wanderer and Rattlechains along with disruptive spells like Spell Queller, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building a board presence. Cards like Supreme Phantom and Skyclave Apparition provide additional support for the spirits strategy, while Brazen Borrower and Shacklegeist offer versatile options for dealing with threats. Slip Out the Back and Sheltered by Ghosts provide protection and evasion for key creatures, ensuring the deck can maintain a strong presence in the game.

The deck focuses on sacrificing and reanimating creatures for value, using cards like Witch's Oven and Mayhem Devil to generate damage and Cauldron Familiar for recurring life gain. It also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Claim the Firstborn to control the board, while utilizing Scavenger's Talent for card advantage. The deck aims to pressure the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ygra, Eater of All and Bloodtithe Harvester, while disrupting their game plan with disruption spells. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggression and disruption.

The deck focuses on aggressive play with a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive spells to apply constant pressure on the opponent. It aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize while utilizing powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out the game quickly. The inclusion of cards like Fear of Missing Out and Blightstep Pathway allows for versatility in combat and provides an advantage in the aggro match-up. The deck's strategy is to be proactive, putting the opponent on the back foot and forcing them to react to your threats.

This deck focuses on quickly building a board presence with efficient creatures and using them to overwhelm the opponent. It combines creatures with powerful abilities like lifegain and token generation to create a fast-paced aggressive strategy. The inclusion of cards like Collected Company allows for flexibility and consistent creature deployment. The deck also includes lands that can produce multiple colors of mana to support the multicolored creatures in the deck. Overall, the key concept is to build a strong board presence and apply pressure early in the game.

The main concept of this Rakdos Aggro deck is to aggressively disrupt the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress while putting pressure on the board with efficient creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Mutavault. The deck also utilizes powerful spells like Fatal Push and Blade of the Oni to control the board and finish off opponents quickly with cards like Fear of Missing Out and Torch the Tower. Additionally, the deck includes powerful threat cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance to further pressure the opponent and close out games.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on quick, aggressive plays to overwhelm the opponent. Utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's hand, while deploying threats like Bloodtithe Harvester and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to apply pressure on the board. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to deal with opposing threats. The inclusion of Mutavault and Blightstep Pathway provides additional versatility and mana fixing. Overall, this deck aims to outpace the opponent and secure victory through a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive spells.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on sacrificing creatures to trigger powerful abilities and disrupt the opponent's board state. The key strategy involves using Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven to generate value with Mayhem Devil, while also utilizing Scavenger's Talent to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. By leveraging a combination of sacrifice effects, removal spells like Fatal Push, and aggressive creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester, this deck aims to apply pressure early and control the game through sacrificing and removal tactics.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, using cards like Fatal Push, Bloodtithe Harvester, and Blade of the Oni to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. It also includes disruptive cards like Duress and Thoughtseize to keep the opponent off balance. The deck also has some powerful finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to close out games quickly. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early pressure and disruptive plays.
